paragraphs: Rabbi Yose of Malchaya: Jerusalem Talmud, Kiddushin 1:5; Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of Emor; Bereshit Rabbah, section 47. Before Rabbi Mana: Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah 2:4; Midrash Eichah, on ‘She descended wondrously.’ When he died, Rabbi Yochanan and Resh Lakish went up to perform kindness, and Rabbi Yitzchak Paska went with them.
